LanguageData.OL_Preview_FromResearched: Only what a recipe the colony has unlocked makes, at a researched bench, whether or not the bench is built or the material is in stock. With nothing ticked, the preview picks from everything this policy allows, made new.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_FromCraftable: Only what the colony can make now: researched, with the bench built and the material in stock. Ticks Researched too.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_FromStorage: The real items in storage now, played out the way the colonist will from what they wear. Researched and Craftable don't apply to them.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_FilterOffInStorage: Off while In storage is ticked: stored items are worn whatever's researched.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_AsIfOnPolicy: Shown as if this colonist were on this policy.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_MaterialTip: This policy's material. Pieces are imagined in it, and priorities that rule pieces out judge them in it. With the best material, an item passes if any material it can be made of passes.\n\nA piece that can't be made of this material, that the policy doesn't allow in it, or that the colony can't afford in it (when picking from what's craftable) is imagined in the best material for this policy's priorities instead. Pieces in storage keep their own material.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_NothingAllowed: This policy allows nothing this colonist can wear.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_NothingResearched: The colony hasn't researched anything this policy allows yet.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_NothingCraftable: The colony can't make anything this policy allows yet.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_NothingToPick: Nothing in storage this policy allows.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_LayerEmptyTip: Nothing is worn on this layer. Click to see what could go here.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_LayerTip: Click to see everything that could go on this layer.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_LayerCoveredTip: {0} is worn on this layer too. Click to see everything that could go on it.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_ChangesPutOn: Your changes put on the pieces marked green.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_ClearMarksTip: Clear the marks. Changes from here on are marked against the outfit as it is now.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_ResetTip: Take this policy back to what its priorities pick: remove its locks and tick every item in Allowed items. Priorities that rule pieces out still untick what they catch. The priorities, the material and the policy's settings stay.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_ResetConfirm: Reset {0} to what its priorities pick?\n\n{1} locks will be removed and {2} items ticked in Allowed items, for every colonist on this policy. Policies built on it lose its locks too.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_ResetNothing: {0} has no locks, and every item its priorities allow is ticked.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_Remove: Remove: forbid it in this policy.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_RemoveLocked: Locked. Unlock it to remove it.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_AllowOnlyTip: Make this policy allow only the items in this outfit, and its locked items. Everything else is unticked in Allowed items, so colonists on this policy wear these and nothing else, and leave a slot empty while its piece doesn't exist. Any material and quality of these items is allowed. Tick items again by hand to undo it.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_AllowOnlyConfirm: Allow only the {0} items in {3}'s outfit in {1}?\n\n{2} items will be unticked in Allowed items, for every colonist on this policy. Locked items stay allowed. Check that colonists of another age or race on it can wear these.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_TriedOnTip: Trying it on. Click its row in the slot list again to stop.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_WhyTie: Ties on every priority: the game's pick.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_WhyAddedCover: Added to cover the torso or legs.
LanguageData.OL_Preview_WithPartners: Counted together with {0} for the rest of what it takes off.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_ClickToOpen: Click to see what else could go here.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_Hint: Click a piece or a layer in the outfit to see what could go there.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_RankTip: The order the colonist would choose these in, 1 being their pick. Click to sort by it.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_SortHint: Click to sort by this column, highest first, then lowest first, then back to the colonist's choice. Right-click goes the other way.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_AddColumn: Add a stat as a column.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_AllowAllTip: Allow every item listed in this policy.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_ClearAllTip: Forbid every item listed in this policy. Locked items stay allowed.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_IsPick: The colonist's pick for this slot.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_WithPartners: Ranked together with {0} for the rest of the slot.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_PieceNotAllowed: This policy allows the item, but not this piece (its quality, condition or another filter).
LanguageData.OL_Slot_CantReach: The colonist can't reach it, or its outfit stand is switched off.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_WontWearLowScore: Scores too low to be put on.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_WontWearExtra: It adds nothing for this policy's priorities, and this policy only adds pieces that help.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_WontWearBlocksVision: The game never puts on apparel that blocks vision by itself.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_WontWearSlaves: The game only puts slave apparel on slaves.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_WontWearMechanitors: The game only puts mechanitor apparel on mechanitors.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_WontWearModRule: The game or another mod rules it out for this colonist.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_WontWearCEShield: Combat Extended only lets a colonist use a shield with a one-handed weapon or none.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_LockWontWear: {0} Locking it won't change what {1} wears.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_Lock: Lock: always wear this, and keep it allowed.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_AllowedCheckbox: Whether this policy allows the item, in any material and quality. Untick to forbid it.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_LockedInBase: Locked in {0}, the policy this one builds on. Unlock it there.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_LockedCheckbox: Locked, so it stays allowed. Unlock it to forbid it.
LanguageData.OL_Slot_ClickToGoBack: Click to go back to the outfit.
LanguageData.OL_Stats_NoPiece: Click a piece to see its stats.
LanguageData.OL_Stats_SortHint: Click to sort the list by this, highest first, then lowest first, then back to the colonist's choice.
LanguageData.OL_Stats_AddPriority: Add this stat as a priority of this policy.
LanguageData.OL_Stats_RemovePriority: Remove this priority from this policy.
LanguageData.OL_Stats_PriorityHeaderTip: A number is the stat's place in this policy's priorities, grey when it comes from the policy this one builds on. + adds a stat as the last priority, and − removes it.
